title: Your Statement of Benefit Charges: Issue and Protest Terms (Employer Benefit Charging)
content:
These are the terms on which the Department issues the statement of benefit charges under Employer Benefit Charging and on which an employer may protest the charges it lists. Each term is set per charge class.

## Statement terms

| Charge class | How often issued | Mailed by (calendar days after the quarter ends) | Delivered | Detail printed for each position |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Separating Employer — Most Recent | Quarterly | 45 | By mail and in the employer portal | Each claimant, week by week |
| Base Period Employer — Proportional Share | Quarterly | 45 | By mail and in the employer portal | Each claimant, week by week |
| Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer | Quarterly | 45 | By mail and in the employer portal | Each claimant, week by week |
| Combined Wage Claim Contributing Employer | Quarterly | 45 | By mail and in the employer portal | Each claimant, week by week |
| Extended Benefits State-Share Employer | Quarterly | 45 | By mail and in the employer portal | Each claimant, week by week |
| Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | Quarterly | 45 | By mail and in the employer portal | Each claimant, week by week |
| Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | Quarterly | 45 | By mail and in the employer portal | Each claimant, week by week |

## Protest terms

| Charge class | Protest window (calendar days after the statement mailing date) | Written protest accepted through | Only grounds not already decided | Decided within (business days after receipt) | A protest denial is appealed on |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Separating Employer — Most Recent | 30 | Employer portal, fax, mail | Yes | 30 | Employer benefit charge appeal docket |
| Base Period Employer — Proportional Share | 30 | Employer portal, fax, mail | Yes | 30 | Employer benefit charge appeal docket |
| Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer | 30 | Employer portal, fax, mail | Yes | 30 | Employer benefit charge appeal docket |
| Combined Wage Claim Contributing Employer | 30 | Employer portal, fax, mail | Yes | 30 | Employer benefit charge appeal docket |
| Extended Benefits State-Share Employer | 30 | Employer portal, fax, mail | Yes | 30 | Employer benefit charge appeal docket |
| Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | 30 | Employer portal, fax, mail | Yes | 30 | Employer benefit charge appeal docket |
| Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | 30 | Employer portal, fax, mail | Yes | 30 | Employer benefit charge appeal docket |

The employer benefit charge appeal docket is the Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Benefit Charge docket.

## Reading these terms

- The two 30-day figures are different units: the protest window is counted in calendar days after the statement mailing date, and the decision period in business days after the protest is received.
- SIDES E-Response is not among the protest channels; a written protest comes through the employer portal, by fax or by mail.
